                            this._bannerInteracted = true;

                userStatus.purposes.consent.enabled = [...new Set(newPurposes)];

                
                userStatus.purposes.consent.disabled = userStatus.purposes.consent.disabled.filter(p => !purposes.includes(p));

                
                const usVendors = userStatus.vendors.consent.enabled;
                const newVendors = [...usVendors, ...vendors]
                userStatus.vendors.consent.enabled = [...new Set(newVendors)];

                
                userStatus.vendors.consent.disabled = userStatus.vendors.consent.disabled.filter(v => !vendors.includes(v));

                return userStatus;
            });
            this.debug('accept: Gave consent to vendors', vendors, 'and purposes', purposes);

            });

                listener: cb
            })

                    this._scriptErrors.shift()();
                }
            }

                    script.setAttribute(key, attrs[key]);
                }
            }
        }

        if (location) {
            location.parentNode.replaceChild(script, location);
        } else {
            document.head.appendChild(script);
        }
    }

<script async>
    const maintenanceConfigEnv = "prod" === 'prod' ? 'prod' : 'test_stage';
    const maintenanceConfigUrl = `https://assets.diepresse.com/layout/diepresse/files/nav/maintenance_banner_config.${maintenanceConfigEnv}.json`;
    let maintenanceBannerShown = false;
    const showMaintenanceBanner = window.showMaintenanceBanner = (content) => {
        let bannerWrapper = document.createElement('div');
        bannerWrapper.classList.add('maintenance-work');
        bannerWrapper.style.color = content.colorText;
        bannerWrapper.style.backgroundColor = content.colorBackground;

        let banner = document.createElement('div');
        banner.classList.add('maintenance-work__inner');
        banner.innerHTML = content.text;

        bannerWrapper.appendChild(banner);

        if (!maintenanceBannerShown) {
            document.getElementById('maintenanceBanner').appendChild(bannerWrapper);
        } else {
            document.getElementById('maintenanceBanner').insertAdjacentElement('beforeend', bannerWrapper);
        }

        maintenanceBannerShown = true;
        bannerWrapper.style.display = 'block';
    }; // expose the function to the whole app

    // Get the maintenance banner config every 5 minutes and cache it in the localStorage
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
        cachedFetch(maintenanceConfigUrl, {
                seconds: 5 * 60,
            }).then(response => {
                if (!response.ok) {
                    console.error('Maintenance banner config response was not ok', response);
                }
                return response.json();
            }).then(data => {
                if (data?.showBanner) {
                    const now = new Date();
                    const startDateTime = new Date(data.timeFrom);
                    const endDateTime = new Date(data.timeTo);

                    // set the banner properties
                    if (now >= startDateTime && now <= endDateTime) {
                        showMaintenanceBanner({
                            text: data.text,
                            colorText: data.colorText,
                            colorBackground: data.colorBackground
                        });
                    }
                }
            }).catch(error => {
                console.error('There was a problem with the fetch operation:', error);
            });
    });
</script>

    function loadScript(src, async, location, onLoad, onError, defer, attrs) {
        console.debug('loading script ' + src);
        var script = document.createElement('SCRIPT');
        script.onload = onLoad;
        script.onerror = onError;
        script.src = src;

        if (async) {
            script.async = 'async';
        }

        if (defer) {
            script.defer = 'defer';
        }

        if (typeof attrs === 'object') {
            for (let key in attrs) {
                if (typeof attrs[key] === 'string') {
                    script.setAttribute(key, attrs[key]);
                }
            }
        }

        if (location) {
            location.parentNode.replaceChild(script, location);
        } else {
            document.head.appendChild(script);
        }
    }

<script async>
    const maintenanceConfigEnv = "prod" === 'prod' ? 'prod' : 'test_stage';
    const maintenanceConfigUrl = `https://assets.diepresse.com/layout/diepresse/files/nav/maintenance_banner_config.${maintenanceConfigEnv}.json`;
    let maintenanceBannerShown = false;
    const showMaintenanceBanner = window.showMaintenanceBanner = (content) => {
        let bannerWrapper = document.createElement('div');
        bannerWrapper.classList.add('maintenance-work');
        bannerWrapper.style.color = content.colorText;
        bannerWrapper.style.backgroundColor = content.colorBackground;

        let banner = document.createElement('div');
        banner.classList.add('maintenance-work__inner');
        banner.innerHTML = content.text;

        bannerWrapper.appendChild(banner);

        if (!maintenanceBannerShown) {
            document.getElementById('maintenanceBanner').appendChild(bannerWrapper);
        } else {
            document.getElementById('maintenanceBanner').insertAdjacentElement('beforeend', bannerWrapper);
        }

        maintenanceBannerShown = true;
        bannerWrapper.style.display = 'block';
    }; // expose the function to the whole app

    // Get the maintenance banner config every 5 minutes and cache it in the localStorage
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
        cachedFetch(maintenanceConfigUrl, {
                seconds: 5 * 60,
            }).then(response => {
                if (!response.ok) {
                    console.error('Maintenance banner config response was not ok', response);
                }
                return response.json();
            }).then(data => {
                if (data?.showBanner) {
                    const now = new Date();
                    const startDateTime = new Date(data.timeFrom);
                    const endDateTime = new Date(data.timeTo);

                    // set the banner properties
                    if (now >= startDateTime && now <= endDateTime) {
                        showMaintenanceBanner({
                            text: data.text,
                            colorText: data.colorText,
                            colorBackground: data.colorBackground
                        });
                    }
                }
            }).catch(error => {
                console.error('There was a problem with the fetch operation:', error);
            });
    });
</script>

    /**
     * Inject and load Javascript from external sources
     *
     * @param src
     * @param async
     * @param location HTMLElement that will be replaced with the injected script tag. If not set, script tag will be added to the head-section as child
     * @param onLoad
     * @param onError
     * @param defer
     * @param attrs Object of attributes to set to the SCRIPT element
     */
    function loadScript(src, async, location, onLoad, onError, defer, attrs) {
        console.debug('loading script ' + src);
        var script = document.createElement('SCRIPT');
        script.onload = onLoad;
        script.onerror = onError;
        script.src = src;

        if (async) {
            script.async = 'async';
        }

        if (defer) {
            script.defer = 'defer';
        }

        if (typeof attrs === 'object') {
            for (let key in attrs) {
                if (typeof attrs[key] === 'string') {
                    script.setAttribute(key, attrs[key]);
                }
            }
        }

        if (location) {
            location.parentNode.replaceChild(script, location);
        } else {
            document.head.appendChild(script);
        }
    }

    /**
     * Inject and load Javascript from external sources. Result will be a Promise
     *
     * @param src
     * @param async
     * @param location HTMLElement that will be replaced with the injected script tag. If not set, script tag will be added to the head-section as child
     * @param defer
     * @param attrs Object of attributes to set to the SCRIPT element
     * @return Promise whether the script was loaded (resolve) or not (reject)
     */
    function loadScriptPromise(src, async, location, defer, attrs) {
        return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
            loadScript(src, async, location, resolve, reject, defer, attrs);
        })
    }

<script async>
    const maintenanceConfigEnv = "prod" === 'prod' ? 'prod' : 'test_stage';
    const maintenanceConfigUrl = `https://assets.diepresse.com/layout/diepresse/files/nav/maintenance_banner_config.${maintenanceConfigEnv}.json`;
    let maintenanceBannerShown = false;
    const showMaintenanceBanner = window.showMaintenanceBanner = (content) => {
        let bannerWrapper = document.createElement('div');
        bannerWrapper.classList.add('maintenance-work');
        bannerWrapper.style.color = content.colorText;
        bannerWrapper.style.backgroundColor = content.colorBackground;

        let banner = document.createElement('div');
        banner.classList.add('maintenance-work__inner');
        banner.innerHTML = content.text;

        bannerWrapper.appendChild(banner);

        if (!maintenanceBannerShown) {
            document.getElementById('maintenanceBanner').appendChild(bannerWrapper);
        } else {
            document.getElementById('maintenanceBanner').insertAdjacentElement('beforeend', bannerWrapper);
        }

        maintenanceBannerShown = true;
        bannerWrapper.style.display = 'block';
    }; // expose the function to the whole app

    // Get the maintenance banner config every 5 minutes and cache it in the localStorage
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
        cachedFetch(maintenanceConfigUrl, {
                seconds: 5 * 60,
            }).then(response => {
                if (!response.ok) {
                    console.error('Maintenance banner config response was not ok', response);
                }
                return response.json();
            }).then(data => {
                if (data?.showBanner) {
                    const now = new Date();
                    const startDateTime = new Date(data.timeFrom);
                    const endDateTime = new Date(data.timeTo);

                    // set the banner properties
                    if (now >= startDateTime && now <= endDateTime) {
                        showMaintenanceBanner({
                            text: data.text,
                            colorText: data.colorText,
                            colorBackground: data.colorBackground
                        });
                    }
                }
            }).catch(error => {
                console.error('There was a problem with the fetch operation:', error);
            });
    });
</script>

                    this.debug(
                        `onVendorConsentChange: No consent required. Script for vendor ${vendorId} will be executed immediately.`
                    );
                    cb(true);
                }

            window.didomiOnReady.push((Didomi) => {
                cb(Didomi.getUserStatus());

                    event: 'consent.changed',

                        this.debug(`onConsentChange: Consent data has been changed.`);
                        cb(Didomi.getUserStatus());
                    }
                });
            });
        },

                window.didomiOnReady.push((Didomi) => {

                        .subscribe((consentStatus) => {

                                consentStatus);
                            resolve(consentStatus);
                        });
                });
            });
        },

        
        checkPurposesConsent(requiredPurposes) {
            return new Promise((resolve) => {
                window.didomiOnReady.push((Didomi) => {
                    const enabledPurposes = Didomi.getUserStatus().purposes.consent.enabled;
                    const consentStatus = requiredPurposes.every((purpose) => enabledPurposes

                    this.debug(`checkPurposesConsent: ConsentStatus is`, consentStatus);
                    resolve(consentStatus);
                })
            })
        },

            return new Promise((resolve) => {
                window.didomiOnReady.push((Didomi) => {
                    resolve(Didomi.getUserStatus());

                'select_personalized_content', 'measure_ad_performance',
                'measure_content_performance', 'market_research', 'improve_products',

                }

                return;
            }

                if (Didomi.isConsentRequired()) {
                    
                    
                    this.debug('onBannerInteracted: Register script for CMP interaction');

                        if (!Didomi.isUserStatusPartial()) {
                            this.debug(

                            );
                            this._bannerInteracted = true;
                            cb();
                        }
                    };

                    
                    if (!Didomi.isUserStatusPartial()) {
                        executeCb();
                    } else {
                        
                        window.didomiEventListeners.push({
                            event: 'notice.hidden',
                            listener: executeCb
                        });

                        
                        window.didomiEventListeners.push({
                            event: 'preferences.hidden',
                            listener: executeCb
                        });
                    }
                } else {
                    
                    this.debug(`onBannerInteracted: No consent required. Executing script.`);
                    cb();
                }
            });
        },

        
        
        
        changeUserStatus(cb) {
            window.didomiOnReady.push((Didomi) => {
                const userStatus = Didomi.getUserStatus();
                const newUserStatus = cb(userStatus);
                Didomi.setUserStatus(newUserStatus);
                this.debug('changeUserStatus: User status has been changed');
            });
        },

        
        
        
        accept(vendors = [], purposes = []) {
            this.changeUserStatus((userStatus) => {
                
                const usPurposes = userStatus.purposes.consent.enabled;
                const newPurposes = [...usPurposes, ...purposes];

                
                
                userStatus.purposes.consent.enabled = [...new Set(newPurposes)];

                
                userStatus.purposes.consent.disabled = userStatus.purposes.consent.disabled.filter(p => !purposes.includes(p));

                
                const usVendors = userStatus.vendors.consent.enabled;
                const newVendors = [...usVendors, ...vendors]
                userStatus.vendors.consent.enabled = [...new Set(newVendors)];

                
                userStatus.vendors.consent.disabled = userStatus.vendors.consent.disabled.filter(v => !vendors.includes(v));

                return userStatus;
            });
            this.debug('accept: Gave consent to vendors', vendors, 'and purposes', purposes);
        },

        
        acceptAll() {
            window.didomiOnReady.push((Didomi) => {
                Didomi.setUserAgreeToAll();
            });
        },

        
        
        addEventListener(event, cb) {
            window.didomiEventListeners.push({
                event: event,
                listener: cb
            })
        },

        
        _scriptErrors: [],
        onScriptError(cb) {
            
            if (typeof cb === 'function') {
                this._scriptErrors.push(cb);
            }

            
            if (window.didomiScriptStatus === 'error') {
                while (this._scriptErrors.length > 0) {
                    this._scriptErrors.shift()();
                }
            }
        }
    }

<script async>
    const maintenanceConfigEnv = "prod" === 'prod' ? 'prod' : 'test_stage';
    const maintenanceConfigUrl = `https://assets.diepresse.com/layout/diepresse/files/nav/maintenance_banner_config.${maintenanceConfigEnv}.json`;
    let maintenanceBannerShown = false;
    const showMaintenanceBanner = window.showMaintenanceBanner = (content) => {
        let bannerWrapper = document.createElement('div');
        bannerWrapper.classList.add('maintenance-work');
        bannerWrapper.style.color = content.colorText;
        bannerWrapper.style.backgroundColor = content.colorBackground;

        let banner = document.createElement('div');
        banner.classList.add('maintenance-work__inner');
        banner.innerHTML = content.text;

        bannerWrapper.appendChild(banner);

        if (!maintenanceBannerShown) {
            document.getElementById('maintenanceBanner').appendChild(bannerWrapper);
        } else {
            document.getElementById('maintenanceBanner').insertAdjacentElement('beforeend', bannerWrapper);
        }

        maintenanceBannerShown = true;
        bannerWrapper.style.display = 'block';
    }; // expose the function to the whole app

    // Get the maintenance banner config every 5 minutes and cache it in the localStorage
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
        cachedFetch(maintenanceConfigUrl, {
                seconds: 5 * 60,
            }).then(response => {
                if (!response.ok) {
                    console.error('Maintenance banner config response was not ok', response);
                }
                return response.json();
            }).then(data => {
                if (data?.showBanner) {
                    const now = new Date();
                    const startDateTime = new Date(data.timeFrom);
                    const endDateTime = new Date(data.timeTo);

                    // set the banner properties
                    if (now >= startDateTime && now <= endDateTime) {
                        showMaintenanceBanner({
                            text: data.text,
                            colorText: data.colorText,
                            colorBackground: data.colorBackground
                        });
                    }
                }
            }).catch(error => {
                console.error('There was a problem with the fetch operation:', error);
            });
    });
</script>

        console.debug('loading script ' + src);

                    script.setAttribute(key, attrs[key]);
                }
            }
        }

        if (location) {
            location.parentNode.replaceChild(script, location);
        } else {
            document.head.appendChild(script);
        }
    }

        } else {
            document.getElementById('maintenanceBanner').insertAdjacentElement('beforeend', bannerWrapper);
        }

        maintenanceBannerShown = true;
        bannerWrapper.style.display = 'block';
    }; // expose the function to the whole app

    // Get the maintenance banner config every 5 minutes and cache it in the localStorage
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
        cachedFetch(maintenanceConfigUrl, {
                seconds: 5 * 60,
            }).then(response => {
                if (!response.ok) {
                    console.error('Maintenance banner config response was not ok', response);
                }
                return response.json();
            }).then(data => {
                if (data?.showBanner) {
                    const now = new Date();
                    const startDateTime = new Date(data.timeFrom);
                    const endDateTime = new Date(data.timeTo);

                    // set the banner properties
                    if (now >= startDateTime && now <= endDateTime) {
                        showMaintenanceBanner({
                            text: data.text,
                            colorText: data.colorText,
                            colorBackground: data.colorBackground
                        });
                    }
                }
            }).catch(error => {
                console.error('There was a problem with the fetch operation:', error);
            });
    });
